from z3 import *

names = ["Eric", "Arnold", "Alice", "Peter"]
styles = ["craftsman", "ranch", "victorian", "colonial"]
drinks = ["water", "tea", "milk", "coffee"]

name_pos = {n: Int("name_" + n) for n in names}
style_pos = {s: Int("style_" + s) for s in styles}
drink_pos = {d: Int("drink_" + d) for d in drinks}

solver = Solver()

for v in list(name_pos.values()) + list(style_pos.values()) + list(drink_pos.values()):
    solver.add(v >= 1)
    solver.add(v <= 4)

solver.add(Distinct(*list(name_pos.values())))
solver.add(Distinct(*list(style_pos.values())))
solver.add(Distinct(*list(drink_pos.values())))

solver.add(name_pos["Eric"] == drink_pos["water"])
solver.add(drink_pos["milk"] == style_pos["victorian"])
solver.add(style_pos["ranch"] < style_pos["craftsman"])
solver.add(name_pos["Eric"] == 3)
solver.add(name_pos["Arnold"] > name_pos["Alice"])
solver.add(style_pos["ranch"] == name_pos["Arnold"])

def next_to(a, b):
    return Or(a == b + 1, b == a + 1)

solver.add(next_to(name_pos["Eric"], style_pos["victorian"]))
solver.add(drink_pos["tea"] != 1)

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()
    name_at = {}
    style_at = {}
    drink_at = {}
    for n in names:
        name_at[model.eval(name_pos[n], True).as_long()] = n
    for s in styles:
        style_at[model.eval(style_pos[s], True).as_long()] = s
    for d in drinks:
        drink_at[model.eval(drink_pos[d], True).as_long()] = d
    for h in range(1, 5):
        print("House {}: {}, {}, {}".format(h, name_at[h], style_at[h], drink_at[h]))
else:
    print("No solution")
```

from z3 import *

names = ["Alice", "Eric", "Bob", "Peter", "Arnold", "Carol"]

name_vars = {n: Int(n.replace(" ", "_")) for n in names}
height_vars = {h: Int(h.replace(" ", "_")) for h in heights}
phone_vars = {p: Int(p.replace(" ", "_")) for p in phones}

s = Solver()

for v in all_vars:
    s.add(v >= 1, v <= 6)

s.add(Distinct(*name_vars.values()))
s.add(Distinct(*height_vars.values()))
s.add(Distinct(*phone_vars.values()))

# Clue 1
s.add(name_vars["Bob"] + 1 == height_vars["tall"])
# Clue 2
s.add(name_vars["Peter"] < phone_vars["iphone 13"])
# Clue 3
s.add(phone_vars["google pixel 6"] < height_vars["very short"])
# Clue 4
s.add(name_vars["Carol"] == height_vars["very tall"])
# Clue 5
s.add(Or(phone_vars["google pixel 6"] - height_vars["short"] == 2,

# Clue 6

# Clue 7
s.add(phone_vars["oneplus 9"] + 1 == height_vars["short"])
# Clue 8

# Clue 9
s.add(height_vars["super tall"] == 1)
# Clue 10
s.add(phone_vars["xiaomi mi 11"] == name_vars["Carol"])
# Clue 11
s.add(phone_vars["google pixel 6"] > name_vars["Eric"])
# Clue 12
s.add(height_vars["short"] == 6)

    m = s.model()

        phone = next(p for p, v in phone_vars.items() if m.eval(v, model_completion=True).as_long() == house)
        print(f"House {house}: {person}, {height}, {phone}")
else:
    print("unsat")

from z3 import *

names = ["Carol", "Peter", "Arnold", "Alice", "Bob", "Eric"]
occupations = ["lawyer", "teacher", "artist", "engineer", "nurse", "doctor"]
pets = ["dog", "hamster", "rabbit", "cat", "fish", "bird"]

name_pos = {n: Int("name_" + n) for n in names}
occ_pos = {o: Int("occ_" + o) for o in occupations}
pet_pos = {p: Int("pet_" + p) for p in pets}

s = Solver()

for v in list(name_pos.values()) + list(occ_pos.values()) + list(pet_pos.values()):
    s.add(And(v >= 1, v <= 6))

s.add(Distinct([name_pos[n] for n in names]))
s.add(Distinct([occ_pos[o] for o in occupations]))
s.add(Distinct([pet_pos[p] for p in pets]))

s.add(name_pos["Carol"] == 3)
s.add(pet_pos["rabbit"] == name_pos["Carol"])
s.add(name_pos["Arnold"] == 5)
s.add(pet_pos["hamster"] != 4)
s.add(pet_pos["fish"] != 4)
s.add(pet_pos["dog"] == name_pos["Peter"])
s.add(occ_pos["nurse"] == name_pos["Eric"])
s.add(occ_pos["teacher"] == 2)
s.add(name_pos["Alice"] < pet_pos["cat"])
s.add(pet_pos["hamster"] < name_pos["Eric"])
s.add(pet_pos["fish"] != 2)
s.add(pet_pos["dog"] + 1 == occ_pos["artist"])
s.add(Or(occ_pos["doctor"] - occ_pos["teacher"] == 1,
         occ_pos["teacher"] - occ_pos["doctor"] == 1))
s.add(pet_pos["fish"] == name_pos["Bob"])
s.add(occ_pos["lawyer"] == pet_pos["hamster"])

if s.check() != sat:
    raise RuntimeError("No solution found")

m = s.model()

def pos_of(var):
    return m.eval(var, model_completion=True).as_long()

name_at = {pos_of(name_pos[n]): n for n in names}
occ_at = {pos_of(occ_pos[o]): o for o in occupations}
pet_at = {pos_of(pet_pos[p]): p for p in pets}

for h in range(1, 7):
    print(f"House {h}: {name_at[h]}, {occ_at[h]}, {pet_at[h]}")

cars = ["ford f150", "honda civic", "chevrolet silverado", "bmw 3 series", "toyota camry", "tesla model 3"]

name_pos = {n: Int(f"name_{n.replace(' ', '_')}") for n in names}
smoothie_pos = {s: Int(f"smoothie_{s.replace(' ', '_')}") for s in smoothies}
edu_pos = {e: Int(f"edu_{e.replace(' ', '_')}") for e in educations}
car_pos = {c: Int(f"car_{c.replace(' ', '_')}") for c in cars}

solver = Solver()

all_positions = (list(name_pos.values()) + list(smoothie_pos.values()) +
                 list(edu_pos.values()) + list(car_pos.values()))
for p in all_positions:
    solver.add(p >= 1, p <= 6)

solver.add(Distinct(list(name_pos.values())))
solver.add(Distinct(list(smoothie_pos.values())))
solver.add(Distinct(list(edu_pos.values())))
solver.add(Distinct(list(car_pos.values())))

solver.add(car_pos["chevrolet silverado"] + 1 == smoothie_pos["cherry"])
solver.add(car_pos["toyota camry"] != 1)
solver.add(car_pos["bmw 3 series"] + 1 == car_pos["ford f150"])
solver.add(smoothie_pos["desert"] == edu_pos["trade school"])
solver.add(edu_pos["associate"] < smoothie_pos["lime"])
solver.add(name_pos["Alice"] + 1 == name_pos["Eric"])
solver.add(edu_pos["bachelor"] == 6)
solver.add(name_pos["Bob"] == car_pos["chevrolet silverado"])
solver.add(edu_pos["associate"] > smoothie_pos["blueberry"])
solver.add(smoothie_pos["dragonfruit"] < smoothie_pos["blueberry"])
solver.add(smoothie_pos["lime"] == car_pos["bmw 3 series"])
solver.add(name_pos["Eric"] > edu_pos["master"])
solver.add(edu_pos["high school"] == 1)
solver.add(edu_pos["doctorate"] == name_pos["Peter"])
solver.add(smoothie_pos["blueberry"] + 1 == smoothie_pos["desert"])
solver.add(name_pos["Carol"] != 4)
solver.add(Or(car_pos["tesla model 3"] == edu_pos["master"] + 1,
              car_pos["tesla model 3"] == edu_pos["master"] - 1))

if solver.check() == sat:
    m = solver.model()
    name_at = {m.eval(v).as_long(): n for n, v in name_pos.items()}
    smoothie_at = {m.eval(v).as_long(): s for s, v in smoothie_pos.items()}
    edu_at = {m.eval(v).as_long(): e for e, v in edu_pos.items()}
    car_at = {m.eval(v).as_long(): c for c, v in car_pos.items()}
    for house in range(1, 7):
        print(f"House {house}: {name_at[house]}, {smoothie_at[house]}, {edu_at[house]}, {car_at[house]}")
else:

```python
from z3 import *

names = ["Bob", "Alice", "Carol", "Arnold", "Eric", "Peter"]
smoothies = ["dragonfruit", "watermelon", "blueberry", "lime", "desert", "cherry"]
educations = ["high school", "doctorate", "master", "associate", "trade school", "bachelor"]
cars = ["ford f150", "honda civic", "chevrolet silverado", "bmw 3 series", "toyota camry", "tesla model 3"]

name_pos = {n: Int(f"name_{n.replace(' ', '_')}") for n in names}
smoothie_pos = {s: Int(f"smoothie_{s.replace(' ', '_')}") for s in smoothies}
edu_pos = {e: Int(f"edu_{e.replace(' ', '_')}") for e in educations}
car_pos = {c: Int(f"car_{c.replace(' ', '_')}") for c in cars}

solver = Solver()

all_positions = (
    list(name_pos.values())
    + list(smoothie_pos.values())
    + list(edu_pos.values())
    + list(car_pos.values())
)
for p in all_positions:
    solver.add(p >= 1, p <= 6)

solver.add(Distinct(*list(name_pos.values())))
solver.add(Distinct(*list(smoothie_pos.values())))
solver.add(Distinct(*list(edu_pos.values())))
solver.add(Distinct(*list(car_pos.values())))

solver.add(car_pos["chevrolet silverado"] + 1 == smoothie_pos["cherry"])
solver.add(car_pos["toyota camry"] != 1)
solver.add(car_pos["bmw 3 series"] + 1 == car_pos["ford f150"])
solver.add(smoothie_pos["desert"] == edu_pos["trade school"])
solver.add(edu_pos["associate"] < smoothie_pos["lime"])
solver.add(name_pos["Alice"] + 1 == name_pos["Eric"])
solver.add(edu_pos["bachelor"] == 6)
solver.add(name_pos["Bob"] == car_pos["chevrolet silverado"])
solver.add(edu_pos["associate"] > smoothie_pos["blueberry"])
solver.add(smoothie_pos["dragonfruit"] < smoothie_pos["blueberry"])
solver.add(smoothie_pos["lime"] == car_pos["bmw 3 series"])
solver.add(name_pos["Eric"] > edu_pos["master"])
solver.add(edu_pos["high school"] == 1)
solver.add(edu_pos["doctorate"] == name_pos["Peter"])
solver.add(smoothie_pos["blueberry"] + 1 == smoothie_pos["desert"])
solver.add(name_pos["Carol"] != 4)
solver.add(Or(car_pos["tesla model 3"] == edu_pos["master"] + 1,
              car_pos["tesla model 3"] == edu_pos["master"] - 1))

if solver.check() == sat:
    m = solver.model()
    name_at = {m.eval(v).as_long(): n for n, v in name_pos.items()}
    smoothie_at = {m.eval(v).as_long(): s for s, v in smoothie_pos.items()}
    edu_at = {m.eval(v).as_long(): e for e, v in edu_pos.items()}
    car_at = {m.eval(v).as_long(): c for c, v in car_pos.items()}
    for house in range(1, 7):
        print(f"House {house}: {name_at[house]}, {smoothie_at[house]}, {edu_at[house]}, {car_at[house]}")
else:
    print("unsat")
```

from z3 import *

names = ["Bob", "Alice", "Carol", "Arnold", "Eric", "Peter"]
smoothies = ["dragonfruit", "watermelon", "blueberry", "lime", "desert", "cherry"]
educations = ["high school", "doctorate", "master", "associate", "trade school", "bachelor"]
cars = ["ford f150", "honda civic", "chevrolet silverado", "bmw 3 series", "toyota camry", "tesla model 3"]

name_pos = {n: Int(f"name_{n.replace(' ', '_')}") for n in names}
smoothie_pos = {s: Int(f"smoothie_{s.replace(' ', '_')}") for s in smoothies}
edu_pos = {e: Int(f"edu_{e.replace(' ', '_')}") for e in educations}
car_pos = {c: Int(f"car_{c.replace(' ', '_')}") for c in cars}

solver = Solver()

all_positions = (
    list(name_pos.values())
    + list(smoothie_pos.values())
    + list(edu_pos.values())
    + list(car_pos.values())
)

for p in all_positions:
    solver.add(p >= 1, p <= 6)

solver.add(Distinct(*list(name_pos.values())))
solver.add(Distinct(*list(smoothie_pos.values())))
solver.add(Distinct(*list(edu_pos.values())))
solver.add(Distinct(*list(car_pos.values())))

solver.add(car_pos["chevrolet silverado"] + 1 == smoothie_pos["cherry"])
solver.add(car_pos["toyota camry"] != 1)
solver.add(car_pos["bmw 3 series"] + 1 == car_pos["ford f150"])
solver.add(smoothie_pos["desert"] == edu_pos["trade school"])
solver.add(edu_pos["associate"] < smoothie_pos["lime"])
solver.add(name_pos["Alice"] + 1 == name_pos["Eric"])
solver.add(edu_pos["bachelor"] == 6)
solver.add(name_pos["Bob"] == car_pos["chevrolet silverado"])
solver.add(edu_pos["associate"] > smoothie_pos["blueberry"])
solver.add(smoothie_pos["dragonfruit"] < smoothie_pos["blueberry"])
solver.add(smoothie_pos["lime"] == car_pos["bmw 3 series"])
solver.add(name_pos["Eric"] > edu_pos["master"])
solver.add(edu_pos["high school"] == 1)
solver.add(edu_pos["doctorate"] == name_pos["Peter"])
solver.add(smoothie_pos["blueberry"] + 1 == smoothie_pos["desert"])
solver.add(name_pos["Carol"] != 4)
solver.add(Or(car_pos["tesla model 3"] == edu_pos["master"] + 1,
              car_pos["tesla model 3"] == edu_pos["master"] - 1))

if solver.check() == sat:
    m = solver.model()
    name_at = {m.eval(v, model_completion=True).as_long(): n for n, v in name_pos.items()}
    smoothie_at = {m.eval(v, model_completion=True).as_long(): s for s, v in smoothie_pos.items()}
    edu_at = {m.eval(v, model_completion=True).as_long(): e for e, v in edu_pos.items()}
    car_at = {m.eval(v, model_completion=True).as_long(): c for c, v in car_pos.items()}

    for house in range(1, 7):
        print(f"House {house}: {name_at[house]}, {smoothie_at[house]}, {edu_at[house]}, {car_at[house]}")
else:
    print("unsat")

```python
from z3 import *

names = ["Arnold", "Peter", "Bob", "Eric", "Carol", "Alice"]
animals = ["horse", "rabbit", "fish", "cat", "bird", "dog"]
occupations = ["engineer", "nurse", "lawyer", "teacher", "artist", "doctor"]
sports = ["basketball", "volleyball", "soccer", "tennis", "baseball", "swimming"]
heights = ["average", "tall", "short", "very short", "very tall", "super tall"]

name = {n: Int(f"name_{n}") for n in names}
animal = {a: Int(f"animal_{a}") for a in animals}
occupation = {o: Int(f"occupation_{o}") for o in occupations}
sport = {s: Int(f"sport_{s}") for s in sports}
height = {h: Int(f"height_{h}") for h in heights}

solver = Solver()

for vars_dict in (name, animal, occupation, sport, height):
    solver.add(Distinct(*vars_dict.values()))
    for v in vars_dict.values():
        solver.add(v >= 0, v <= 5)

solver.add(occupation["engineer"] == animal["dog"])
solver.add(height["average"] < height["short"])
solver.add(height["average"] + 1 == animal["rabbit"])
solver.add(height["tall"] < height["very short"])
solver.add(name["Arnold"] == animal["cat"])
solver.add(animal["horse"] == occupation["teacher"])
solver.add(name["Carol"] == sport["soccer"])
solver.add(height["tall"] == sport["volleyball"])
solver.add(occupation["lawyer"] == 4)
solver.add(sport["tennis"] == occupation["teacher"])
solver.add(height["average"] == sport["swimming"])
solver.add(sport["baseball"] + 1 == occupation["engineer"])
solver.add(name["Peter"] == occupation["nurse"])
solver.add(name["Bob"] > occupation["artist"])
solver.add(occupation["teacher"] + 1 == sport["soccer"])
solver.add(animal["rabbit"] == name["Alice"])
solver.add(animal["fish"] == name["Carol"])
solver.add(sport["baseball"] == 0)
solver.add(animal["cat"] > height["very short"])
solver.add(height["super tall"] == 4)

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()
    grid = [dict() for _ in range(6)]
    for category, vars_dict in (("Name", name), ("Animal", animal), ("Occupation", occupation), ("Sport", sport), ("Height", height)):
        for attr, var in vars_dict.items():
            house = model.eval(var, model_completion=True).as_long()
            grid[house][category] = attr
    for i in range(6):
        print(f"House {i+1}: {grid[i]['Name']}, {grid[i]['Animal']}, {grid[i]['Occupation']}, {grid[i]['Sport']}, {grid[i]['Height']}")
else:
    print("unsat")
```

from z3 import *

Eric, Arnold = Ints('Eric Arnold')
Bella, Fred = Ints('Bella Fred')
cat, horse = Ints('cat horse')
Aniya, Holly = Ints('Aniya Holly')

all_vars = [Eric, Arnold, Bella, Fred, cat, horse, Aniya, Holly]

s = Solver()
for v in all_vars:
    s.add(Or(v == 1, v == 2))

s.add(Distinct(Eric, Arnold))
s.add(Distinct(Bella, Fred))
s.add(Distinct(cat, horse))
s.add(Distinct(Aniya, Holly))

s.add(Holly == Bella)
s.add(Arnold != 1)
s.add(Holly > horse)

if s.check() == sat:
    model = s.model()

    def value_at(house, attrs):
        for a in attrs:
            if model.eval(a, model_completion=True).as_long() == house:
                return str(a)

    for h in (1, 2):
        print(f"House {h}: {value_at(h, [Eric, Arnold])}, {value_at(h, [Bella, Fred])}, {value_at(h, [cat, horse])}, {value_at(h, [Aniya, Holly])}")

from z3 import *

s = Solver()

names = ["Peter", "Eric", "Arnold", "Alice"]

s.add(genre_vars[2] + 1 == name_vars[0])      # classical directly left of Peter
s.add(name_vars[2] == genre_vars[0])          # Arnold loves jazz
s.add(genre_vars[1] != 2)                     # rock not in house 2
s.add(genre_vars[1] + 1 == genre_vars[3])     # rock directly left of pop

if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    person_at = {}
    music_at = {}

    for name, v in zip(names, name_vars):
        person_at[m.eval(v, model_completion=True).as_long()] = name

    for genre, v in zip(genres, genre_vars):
        music_at[m.eval(v, model_completion=True).as_long()] = genre

    for house in range(1, 5):
        print(f"House {house}: {person_at[house]}, {music_at[house]}")
else:
    print("unsat")
```

from z3 import *

s = Solver()

names = ["Peter", "Eric", "Arnold", "Alice"]
genres = ["jazz", "rock", "classical", "pop"]

name_vars = [Int(n) for n in names]
genre_vars = [Int(g) for g in genres]

for v in name_vars + genre_vars:
    s.add(v >= 1, v <= 4)

s.add(Distinct(*name_vars))
s.add(Distinct(*genre_vars))

# Clues encoded as house-position relations.
s.add(name_vars[3] + 1 == name_vars[0])   # Alice is directly left of Peter.
s.add(genre_vars[2] + 1 == name_vars[0])  # Classical is directly left of Peter.
s.add(name_vars[2] == genre_vars[0])      # Arnold loves jazz.
s.add(genre_vars[1] != 2)                 # Rock is not in house 2.
s.add(genre_vars[1] + 1 == genre_vars[3]) # Rock is directly left of Pop.

if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    person_at = {}
    music_at = {}

    for name, v in zip(names, name_vars):
        person_at[m.eval(v, model_completion=True).as_long()] = name

    for genre, v in zip(genres, genre_vars):
        music_at[m.eval(v, model_completion=True).as_long()] = genre

    for house in range(1, 5):
        print(f"House {house}: {person_at[house]}, {music_at[house]}")
else:
    print("unsat")

```python
from z3 import *

def adjacent(x, y):
    return Or(x == y + 1, y == x + 1)

s = Solver()

Arnold = Int('Arnold')
Eric = Int('Eric')
animal_cat = Int('animal_cat')
animal_horse = Int('animal_horse')
phone_samsung = Int('phone_samsung')
phone_iphone = Int('phone_iphone')
pet_cat = Int('pet_cat')
pet_dog = Int('pet_dog')
cigar_pall_mall = Int('cigar_pall_mall')
cigar_prince = Int('cigar_prince')

vars = [Arnold, Eric, animal_cat, animal_horse, phone_samsung, phone_iphone, pet_cat, pet_dog, cigar_pall_mall, cigar_prince]
for v in vars:
    s.add(v >= 1, v <= 2)

s.add(Distinct(Arnold, Eric))
s.add(Distinct(animal_cat, animal_horse))
s.add(Distinct(phone_samsung, phone_iphone))
s.add(Distinct(pet_cat, pet_dog))
s.add(Distinct(cigar_pall_mall, cigar_prince))

s.add(adjacent(Arnold, phone_samsung))
s.add(adjacent(cigar_pall_mall, Eric))
s.add(pet_dog == Eric - 1)
s.add(adjacent(animal_cat, phone_samsung))

if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()

    def hpos(v):
        return m.eval(v, model_completion=True).as_long()

    names = {}
    for v, label in [(Arnold, "Arnold"), (Eric, "Eric")]:
        names[hpos(v)] = label

    animals = {}
    for v, label in [(animal_cat, "cat"), (animal_horse, "horse")]:
        animals[hpos(v)] = label

    phones = {}
    for v, label in [(phone_samsung, "samsung galaxy s21"), (phone_iphone, "iphone 13")]:
        phones[hpos(v)] = label

    pets = {}
    for v, label in [(pet_cat, "cat"), (pet_dog, "dog")]:
        pets[hpos(v)] = label

    cigars = {}
    for v, label in [(cigar_pall_mall, "pall mall"), (cigar_prince, "prince")]:
        cigars[hpos(v)] = label

    for h in range(1, 3):
        print(f"House {h}: {names[h]}, {animals[h]}, {phones[h]}, {pets[h]}, {cigars[h]}")
else:
    print("unsat")
```

from z3 import *

categories = {
    "name": ["Carol", "Eric", "Peter", "Alice", "Bob", "Arnold"],
    "lunch": ["spaghetti", "soup", "grilled cheese", "stir fry", "stew", "pizza"],
    "color": ["green", "purple", "blue", "red", "white", "yellow"],
    "mother": ["Holly", "Penny", "Aniya", "Kailyn", "Sarah", "Janelle"],
    "style": ["colonial", "craftsman", "modern", "ranch", "victorian", "mediterranean"]
}

pos = {}
for cat, vals in categories.items():
    for val in vals:
        pos[(cat, val)] = Int(f"{cat}_{val.replace(' ', '_')}")

solver = Solver()

for var in pos.values():
    solver.add(var >= 1, var <= 6)

for cat, vals in categories.items():
    solver.add(Distinct([pos[(cat, val)] for val in vals]))

def adjacent(a, b):
    return Or(a - b == 1, b - a == 1)

solver.add(pos[("mother", "Janelle")] == pos[("style", "colonial")])
solver.add(pos[("name", "Peter")] == pos[("color", "green")])
solver.add(pos[("color", "blue")] + 1 == pos[("lunch", "spaghetti")])
solver.add(pos[("mother", "Penny")] + 1 == pos[("color", "red")])
solver.add(pos[("color", "blue")] == pos[("mother", "Penny")])
solver.add(pos[("mother", "Aniya")] + 1 == pos[("color", "green")])
solver.add(pos[("color", "white")] < pos[("mother", "Janelle")])
solver.add(pos[("name", "Eric")] == pos[("lunch", "grilled cheese")])
solver.add(pos[("mother", "Holly")] + 1 == pos[("name", "Alice")])
solver.add(adjacent(pos[("mother", "Holly")], pos[("lunch", "stew")]))
solver.add(pos[("name", "Alice")] == pos[("style", "ranch")])
solver.add(pos[("name", "Carol")] != 6)
solver.add(pos[("lunch", "stir fry")] == pos[("color", "purple")])
solver.add(adjacent(pos[("color", "red")], pos[("style", "colonial")]))
solver.add(pos[("lunch", "soup")] == pos[("name", "Peter")])
solver.add(pos[("lunch", "pizza")] < pos[("mother", "Sarah")])
solver.add(pos[("style", "victorian")] == pos[("lunch", "grilled cheese")])
solver.add(pos[("lunch", "spaghetti")] != 5)
solver.add(Or(pos[("lunch", "grilled cheese")] - pos[("mother", "Aniya")] == 3,
              pos[("mother", "Aniya")] - pos[("lunch", "grilled cheese")] == 3))
solver.add(pos[("name", "Arnold")] == pos[("color", "red")])
solver.add(pos[("style", "modern")] == pos[("name", "Arnold")])
solver.add(pos[("color", "yellow")] == pos[("style", "mediterranean")])

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()
    for house_num in range(1, 7):
        attrs = []
        for cat in ["name", "lunch", "color", "mother", "style"]:
            for val in categories[cat]:
                if model.eval(pos[(cat, val)]).as_long() == house_num:
                    attrs.append(val)
        print(f"House {house_num}: " + ", ".join(attrs))
else:
    print("unsat")

from z3 import *

solver = Solver()
HOUSES = [1, 2, 3]

for v in list(name.values()) + list(lunch.values()) + list(color.values()):
    solver.add(v >= 1, v <= 3)

solver.add(Distinct(list(name.values())))
solver.add(Distinct(list(lunch.values())))
solver.add(Distinct(list(color.values())))

# The person who loves the spaghetti eater.
lse = Int("lse")
solver.add(lse >= 1, lse <= 3)

Loves = Function("Loves", IntSort(), IntSort(), BoolSort())
solver.add(Loves(lse, lunch["spaghetti"]))

# Clue 2: This person loves yellow.
solver.add(lse == color["yellow"])

# Clue 5: This person is Eric.
solver.add(lse == name["Eric"])

# Clue 4: Peter is directly left of this person.
solver.add(name["Peter"] + 1 == lse)

# Clue 1: Red and yellow are next to each other.
solver.add(Or(color["red"] - color["yellow"] == 1,
              color["yellow"] - color["red"] == 1))

# Clue 3: Pizza and red are next to each other.
solver.add(Or(lunch["pizza"] - color["red"] == 1,
              color["red"] - lunch["pizza"] == 1))

# "The person who loves the spaghetti eater" is unique.
for h in HOUSES:
    solver.add(Implies(lse != IntVal(h), Not(Loves(IntVal(h), lunch["spaghetti"]))))

if solver.check() == sat:
    m = solver.model()

    def label_at(mapping, house):
        for attribute, var in mapping.items():
            if m.eval(var, model_completion=True).as_long() == house:
                return attribute
        raise RuntimeError("missing attribute")

    for house in HOUSES:
        nm = label_at(name, house)
        ln = label_at(lunch, house)
        cl = label_at(color, house)
        print(f"House {house}: {nm}, {ln}, {cl}")
else:
    print("unsat")

color_yellow = Int("color_yellow")

height_short = Int("height_short")

for var in [

from z3 import *

# House positions are 1, 2, 3 from left to right.
arnold = Int("Arnold")
eric = Int("Eric")
peter = Int("Peter")

mystery = Int("mystery")
romance = Int("romance")
science_fiction = Int("science fiction")

google_pixel_6 = Int("google pixel 6")
iphone_13 = Int("iphone 13")
samsung_galaxy_s21 = Int("samsung galaxy s21")

short = Int("short")
very_short = Int("very short")
average = Int("average")

daffodils = Int("daffodils")
lilies = Int("lilies")
carnations = Int("carnations")

pizza = Int("pizza")
grilled_cheese = Int("grilled cheese")
spaghetti = Int("spaghetti")

solver = Solver()

name_vars = [arnold, eric, peter]
genre_vars = [mystery, romance, science_fiction]
phone_vars = [google_pixel_6, iphone_13, samsung_galaxy_s21]
height_vars = [short, very_short, average]
flower_vars = [daffodils, lilies, carnations]
lunch_vars = [pizza, grilled_cheese, spaghetti]

all_vars = name_vars + genre_vars + phone_vars + height_vars + flower_vars + lunch_vars

for var in all_vars:
    solver.add(var >= 1, var <= 3)

solver.add(Distinct(*name_vars))
solver.add(Distinct(*genre_vars))
solver.add(Distinct(*phone_vars))
solver.add(Distinct(*height_vars))
solver.add(Distinct(*flower_vars))
solver.add(Distinct(*lunch_vars))

# Clues
solver.add(samsung_galaxy_s21 == short)
solver.add(carnations + 1 == iphone_13)
solver.add(peter == romance)
solver.add(grilled_cheese != 1)
solver.add(arnold == science_fiction)
solver.add(daffodils == very_short)
solver.add(samsung_galaxy_s21 == science_fiction)
solver.add(science_fiction == pizza)
solver.add(arnold == 3)
solver.add(peter == very_short)

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()

    categories = [
        [(arnold, "Arnold"), (eric, "Eric"), (peter, "Peter")],
        [(mystery, "mystery"), (romance, "romance"), (science_fiction, "science fiction")],
        [(google_pixel_6, "google pixel 6"), (iphone_13, "iphone 13"), (samsung_galaxy_s21, "samsung galaxy s21")],
        [(short, "short"), (very_short, "very short"), (average, "average")],
        [(daffodils, "daffodils"), (lilies, "lilies"), (carnations, "carnations")],
        [(pizza, "pizza"), (grilled_cheese, "grilled cheese"), (spaghetti, "spaghetti")],
    ]

    def attribute_for(category, house):
        for var, label in category:
            if model.evaluate(var).as_long() == house:
                return label
        return "?"

    for house in range(1, 4):
        row = [attribute_for(category, house) for category in categories]
        print(f"House {house}: " + ", ".join(row))
else:
    print("unsat")

from z3 import *

Peter = Int('Peter')
Eric = Int('Eric')
Arnold = Int('Arnold')

pop = Int('pop')
rock = Int('rock')

jan = Int('jan')
april = Int('april')

desert = Int('desert')
cherry = Int('cherry')

swede = Int('swede')
dane = Int('dane')
brit = Int('brit')

white = Int('white')
red = Int('red')
yellow = Int('yellow')

name_vars = [Peter, Eric, Arnold]
music_vars = [classical, pop, rock]
month_vars = [sept, jan, april]
smoothie_vars = [watermelon, desert, cherry]
nationality_vars = [swede, dane, brit]
color_vars = [white, red, yellow]

all_vars = name_vars + music_vars + month_vars + smoothie_vars + nationality_vars + color_vars

s = Solver()

s.add(Distinct(*music_vars))

s.add(Distinct(*smoothie_vars))
s.add(Distinct(*nationality_vars))
s.add(Distinct(*color_vars))

s.add(desert + 1 == swede)
s.add(classical == red)
s.add(brit == rock)
s.add(white + 1 == desert)
s.add(sept == classical)
s.add(desert + 1 == watermelon)

if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    rows = []
    for i in range(3):

        for var_list, labels in [

                    break

    print("\n".join(rows))

from z3 import *

Fred, Bella, Samantha, Meredith, Timothy = Ints('Fred Bella Samantha Meredith Timothy')
painting, photography, cooking, knitting, gardening = Ints('painting photography cooking knitting gardening')

solver = Solver()

variables = [Arnold, Alice, Eric, Peter, Bob, Fred, Bella, Samantha, Meredith, Timothy, painting, photography, cooking, knitting, gardening]
for v in variables:
    solver.add(v >= 1, v <= 5)

solver.add(Distinct(Arnold, Alice, Eric, Peter, Bob))
solver.add(Distinct(Fred, Bella, Samantha, Meredith, Timothy))
solver.add(Distinct(painting, photography, cooking, knitting, gardening))

solver.add(Fred == gardening)
solver.add(Meredith + 1 == gardening)
solver.add(Bob != 2)
solver.add(Eric + 1 == painting)
solver.add(cooking != 4)
solver.add(Bob + 1 == Alice)
solver.add(Timothy + 1 == cooking)
solver.add(Bella == knitting)
solver.add(Bella < photography)
solver.add(painting == Samantha)
solver.add(Peter != 3)

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()

    name_items = [(Arnold, "Arnold"), (Alice, "Alice"), (Eric, "Eric"), (Peter, "Peter"), (Bob, "Bob")]
    child_items = [(Fred, "Fred"), (Bella, "Bella"), (Samantha, "Samantha"), (Meredith, "Meredith"), (Timothy, "Timothy")]
    hobby_items = [(painting, "painting"), (photography, "photography"), (cooking, "cooking"), (knitting, "knitting"), (gardening, "gardening")]

    def item_at(house, items):
        for var, label in items:
            if model.eval(var).as_long() == house:
                return label
        return "?"

    for house in range(1, 6):
        name = item_at(house, name_items)
        child = item_at(house, child_items)
        hobby = item_at(house, hobby_items)
        print(f"House {house}: {name}, {child}, {hobby}")
else:
    print("unsat")
```

from z3 import *

Arnold, Alice, Eric, Peter, Bob = Ints('Arnold Alice Eric Peter Bob')
Fred, Bella, Samantha, Meredith, Timothy = Ints('Fred Bella Samantha Meredith Timothy')
painting, photography, cooking, knitting, gardening = Ints('painting photography cooking knitting gardening')

solver = Solver()

variables = [
    Arnold, Alice, Eric, Peter, Bob,
    Fred, Bella, Samantha, Meredith, Timothy,
    painting, photography, cooking, knitting, gardening
]

for v in variables:
    solver.add(v >= 1, v <= 5)

solver.add(Distinct(Arnold, Alice, Eric, Peter, Bob))
solver.add(Distinct(Fred, Bella, Samantha, Meredith, Timothy))
solver.add(Distinct(painting, photography, cooking, knitting, gardening))

solver.add(Fred == gardening)
solver.add(Meredith + 1 == gardening)
solver.add(Bob != 2)
solver.add(Eric + 1 == painting)
solver.add(cooking != 4)
solver.add(Bob + 1 == Alice)
solver.add(Timothy + 1 == cooking)
solver.add(Bella == knitting)
solver.add(Bella < photography)
solver.add(painting == Samantha)
solver.add(Peter != 3)

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()

    name_items = [
        (Arnold, "Arnold"), (Alice, "Alice"), (Eric, "Eric"),
        (Peter, "Peter"), (Bob, "Bob")
    ]
    child_items = [
        (Fred, "Fred"), (Bella, "Bella"), (Samantha, "Samantha"),
        (Meredith, "Meredith"), (Timothy, "Timothy")
    ]
    hobby_items = [
        (painting, "painting"), (photography, "photography"),
        (cooking, "cooking"), (knitting, "knitting"), (gardening, "gardening")
    ]

    def item_at(house, items):
        for var, label in items:
            if model.eval(var).as_long() == house:
                return label
        return "?"

    for house in range(1, 6):
        name = item_at(house, name_items)
        child = item_at(house, child_items)
        hobby = item_at(house, hobby_items)
        print(f"House {house}: {name}, {child}, {hobby}")
else:
    print("unsat")

from z3 import *

ERIC, ARNOLD, PETER = 0, 1, 2
BEACH, MOUNTAIN, CITY = 0, 1, 2
HIGH_SCHOOL, BACHELOR, ASSOCIATE = 0, 1, 2
CAT, BIRD, HORSE = 0, 1, 2

houses = [1, 2, 3]

name = {h: Int(f"name_{h}") for h in houses}
vacation = {h: Int(f"vacation_{h}") for h in houses}
education = {h: Int(f"education_{h}") for h in houses}
animal = {h: Int(f"animal_{h}") for h in houses}

solver = Solver()

def domain_and_distinct(vars, n):
    for v in vars.values():
        solver.add(v >= 0, v < n)
    solver.add(Distinct([vars[h] for h in houses]))

domain_and_distinct(name, 3)
domain_and_distinct(vacation, 3)
domain_and_distinct(education, 3)
domain_and_distinct(animal, 3)

# Clue 1
for h in houses:
    solver.add(Implies(name[h] == ERIC, education[h] == ASSOCIATE))
    solver.add(Implies(education[h] == ASSOCIATE, name[h] == ERIC))
# Alternative equivalence.
# Clue 2
solver.add(vacation[2] == MOUNTAIN)

# Clue 3
for i in houses:
    for j in houses:
        solver.add(Implies(And(name[i] == ARNOLD, animal[j] == CAT), i > j))

# Clue 4
for h in houses:
    solver.add(Implies(animal[h] == BIRD, vacation[h] == MOUNTAIN))
    solver.add(Implies(vacation[h] == MOUNTAIN, animal[h] == BIRD))

# Clue 5
for i in houses:
    for j in houses:
        solver.add(Implies(And(education[i] == HIGH_SCHOOL, vacation[j] == BEACH), i > j))

# Clue 6
solver.add(education[3] == HIGH_SCHOOL)

# Clue 7
solver.add(education[1] != ASSOCIATE)

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()
    names = ["Eric", "Arnold", "Peter"]
    vacations = ["beach", "mountain", "city"]
    educations = ["high school", "bachelor", "associate"]
    animals = ["cat", "bird", "horse"]

    for h in houses:
        name_val = model.eval(name[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        vacation_val = model.eval(vacation[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        education_val = model.eval(education[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        animal_val = model.eval(animal[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        print(f"House {h}: {names[name_val]}, {vacations[vacation_val]}, {educations[education_val]}, {animals[animal_val]}")
else:
    print("unsat")

from z3 import *

# Attribute values are encoded as integers 0..2.
ERIC, ARNOLD, PETER = 0, 1, 2
BEACH, MOUNTAIN, CITY = 0, 1, 2
HIGH_SCHOOL, BACHELOR, ASSOCIATE = 0, 1, 2
CAT, BIRD, HORSE = 0, 1, 2

houses = [1, 2, 3]

name = {h: Int(f"name_{h}") for h in houses}
vacation = {h: Int(f"vacation_{h}") for h in houses}
education = {h: Int(f"education_{h}") for h in houses}
animal = {h: Int(f"animal_{h}") for h in houses}

solver = Solver()

def add_category(vars, values):
    for h in houses:
        solver.add(vars[h] >= 0, vars[h] < len(values))
    solver.add(Distinct([vars[h] for h in houses]))

add_category(name, ["Eric", "Arnold", "Peter"])
add_category(vacation, ["beach", "mountain", "city"])
add_category(education, ["high school", "bachelor", "associate"])
add_category(animal, ["cat", "bird", "horse"])

def position(var, val):
    return Sum([If(var[h] == val, h, 0) for h in houses])

# Clue 1
for h in houses:
    solver.add(Implies(name[h] == ERIC, education[h] == ASSOCIATE))
    solver.add(Implies(education[h] == ASSOCIATE, name[h] == ERIC))

# Clue 2
solver.add(vacation[2] == MOUNTAIN)

# Clue 3
solver.add(position(name, ARNOLD) > position(animal, CAT))

# Clue 4
for h in houses:
    solver.add(Implies(animal[h] == BIRD, vacation[h] == MOUNTAIN))
    solver.add(Implies(vacation[h] == MOUNTAIN, animal[h] == BIRD))

# Clue 5
solver.add(position(education, HIGH_SCHOOL) > position(vacation, BEACH))

# Clue 6
solver.add(education[3] == HIGH_SCHOOL)

# Clue 7
solver.add(education[1] != ASSOCIATE)

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()
    name_values = ["Eric", "Arnold", "Peter"]
    vacation_values = ["beach", "mountain", "city"]
    education_values = ["high school", "bachelor", "associate"]
    animal_values = ["cat", "bird", "horse"]

    for h in houses:
        n = model.eval(name[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        v = model.eval(vacation[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        e = model.eval(education[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        a = model.eval(animal[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        print(f"House {h}: {name_values[n]}, {vacation_values[v]}, {education_values[e]}, {animal_values[a]}")
else:
    print("unsat")

from z3 import *

ERIC, ARNOLD, PETER = 0, 1, 2
BEACH, MOUNTAIN, CITY = 0, 1, 2
HIGH_SCHOOL, BACHELOR, ASSOCIATE = 0, 1, 2
CAT, BIRD, HORSE = 0, 1, 2

name_labels = ["Eric", "Arnold", "Peter"]
vacation_labels = ["beach", "mountain", "city"]
education_labels = ["high school", "bachelor", "associate"]
animal_labels = ["cat", "bird", "horse"]

houses = [1, 2, 3]

name = {h: Int(f"name_{h}") for h in houses}
vacation = {h: Int(f"vacation_{h}") for h in houses}
education = {h: Int(f"education_{h}") for h in houses}
animal = {h: Int(f"animal_{h}") for h in houses}

solver = Solver()

def add_category(var_map, count):
    for h in houses:
        solver.add(var_map[h] >= 0, var_map[h] < count)
    solver.add(Distinct([var_map[h] for h in houses]))

add_category(name, len(name_labels))
add_category(vacation, len(vacation_labels))
add_category(education, len(education_labels))
add_category(animal, len(animal_labels))

def position(var_map, value):
    return Sum([If(var_map[h] == value, h, 0) for h in houses])

# Clue 1
for h in houses:
    solver.add(Implies(name[h] == ERIC, education[h] == ASSOCIATE))
    solver.add(Implies(education[h] == ASSOCIATE, name[h] == ERIC))

# Clue 2
solver.add(vacation[2] == MOUNTAIN)

# Clue 3
solver.add(position(name, ARNOLD) > position(animal, CAT))

# Clue 4
for h in houses:
    solver.add(Implies(animal[h] == BIRD, vacation[h] == MOUNTAIN))
    solver.add(Implies(vacation[h] == MOUNTAIN, animal[h] == BIRD))

# Clue 5
solver.add(position(education, HIGH_SCHOOL) > position(vacation, BEACH))

# Clue 6
solver.add(education[3] == HIGH_SCHOOL)

# Clue 7
solver.add(education[1] != ASSOCIATE)

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()
    for h in houses:
        n = model.eval(name[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        v = model.eval(vacation[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        e = model.eval(education[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        a = model.eval(animal[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        print(f"House {h}: {name_labels[n]}, {vacation_labels[v]}, {education_labels[e]}, {animal_labels[a]}")
else:
    print("unsat")
```

from z3 import *

ERIC, ARNOLD, PETER = 0, 1, 2
BEACH, MOUNTAIN, CITY = 0, 1, 2
HIGH_SCHOOL, BACHELOR, ASSOCIATE = 0, 1, 2
CAT, BIRD, HORSE = 0, 1, 2

name_labels = ["Eric", "Arnold", "Peter"]
vacation_labels = ["beach", "mountain", "city"]
education_labels = ["high school", "bachelor", "associate"]
animal_labels = ["cat", "bird", "horse"]

houses = [1, 2, 3]

name = {h: Int(f"name_{h}") for h in houses}
vacation = {h: Int(f"vacation_{h}") for h in houses}
education = {h: Int(f"education_{h}") for h in houses}
animal = {h: Int(f"animal_{h}") for h in houses}

solver = Solver()

def add_category(var_map, count):
    for h in houses:
        solver.add(var_map[h] >= 0, var_map[h] < count)
    solver.add(Distinct([var_map[h] for h in houses]))

add_category(name, 3)
add_category(vacation, 3)
add_category(education, 3)
add_category(animal, 3)

def position(var_map, value):
    return Sum([If(var_map[h] == value, h, 0) for h in houses])

# Clue 1: Eric has the associate's degree.
for h in houses:
    solver.add(Implies(name[h] == ERIC, education[h] == ASSOCIATE))
    solver.add(Implies(education[h] == ASSOCIATE, name[h] == ERIC))

# Clue 2: Mountain vacation is in house 2.
solver.add(vacation[2] == MOUNTAIN)

# Clue 3: Arnold is right of the cat lover.
solver.add(position(name, ARNOLD) > position(animal, CAT))

# Clue 4: The bird keeper likes mountains.
for h in houses:
    solver.add(Implies(animal[h] == BIRD, vacation[h] == MOUNTAIN))
    solver.add(Implies(vacation[h] == MOUNTAIN, animal[h] == BIRD))

# Clue 5: High school diploma is right of the beach vacation.
solver.add(position(education, HIGH_SCHOOL) > position(vacation, BEACH))

# Clue 6: High school diploma is in house 3.
solver.add(education[3] == HIGH_SCHOOL)

# Clue 7: Associate's degree is not in house 1.
solver.add(education[1] != ASSOCIATE)

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()
    for h in houses:
        n = model.eval(name[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        v = model.eval(vacation[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        e = model.eval(education[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        a = model.eval(animal[h], model_completion=True).as_long()
        print(f"House {h}: {name_labels[n]}, {vacation_labels[v]}, {education_labels[e]}, {animal_labels[a]}")
else:
    print("unsat")

from z3 import *

def one_house_between(a, b):
    return Or(a + 2 == b, b + 2 == a)

s = Solver()

Alice, Peter, Bob, Eric, Arnold = Ints('Alice Peter Bob Eric Arnold')
tulips, daffodils, lilies, roses, carnations = Ints('tulips daffodils lilies roses carnations')
Fred, Bella, Timothy, Meredith, Samantha = Ints('Fred Bella Timothy Meredith Samantha')
high_school, bachelor, doctorate, master, associate = Ints('high_school bachelor doctorate master associate')
cat, fish, dog, horse, bird = Ints('cat fish dog horse bird')

all_vars = [Alice, Peter, Bob, Eric, Arnold,
            tulips, daffodils, lilies, roses, carnations,
            Fred, Bella, Timothy, Meredith, Samantha,
            high_school, bachelor, doctorate, master, associate,
            cat, fish, dog, horse, bird]

for v in all_vars:
    s.add(1 <= v, v <= 5)

names = [Alice, Peter, Bob, Eric, Arnold]
flowers = [tulips, daffodils, lilies, roses, carnations]
children = [Fred, Bella, Timothy, Meredith, Samantha]
educations = [high_school, bachelor, doctorate, master, associate]
animals = [cat, fish, dog, horse, bird]

for group in [names, flowers, children, educations, animals]:
    s.add(Distinct(*group))

s.add(Peter > dog)
s.add(one_house_between(carnations, bachelor))
s.add(one_house_between(doctorate, cat))
s.add(associate + 1 == tulips)
s.add(one_house_between(cat, horse))
s.add(Fred < bachelor)
s.add(Meredith != 3)
s.add(master == Bella)
s.add(bachelor == Bob)
s.add(Timothy == daffodils)
s.add(Samantha == Bob)
s.add(Arnold + 1 == Peter)
s.add(bird + 1 == daffodils)
s.add(roses == bird)
s.add(one_house_between(dog, fish))
s.add(tulips == Eric)

    m = s.model()

    def lookup(items, pos):
        for var, label in items:
            if m.eval(var, model_completion=True).as_long() == pos:
                return label
        return "?"

    name_items = [(Alice, "Alice"), (Peter, "Peter"), (Bob, "Bob"), (Eric, "Eric"), (Arnold, "Arnold")]
    flower_items = [(tulips, "tulips"), (daffodils, "daffodils"), (lilies, "lilies"), (roses, "roses"), (carnations, "carnations")]
    child_items = [(Fred, "Fred"), (Bella, "Bella"), (Timothy, "Timothy"), (Meredith, "Meredith"), (Samantha, "Samantha")]
    edu_items = [(high_school, "high school"), (bachelor, "bachelor"), (doctorate, "doctorate"), (master, "master"), (associate, "associate")]
    animal_items = [(cat, "cat"), (fish, "fish"), (dog, "dog"), (horse, "horse"), (bird, "bird")]

        child = lookup(child_items, h)

        print("House {}: {}, {}, {}, {}, {}".format(h, name, flower, child, edu, animal))

from z3 import *

def one_house_between(a, b):
    return Or(a + 2 == b, b + 2 == a)

s = Solver()

Alice, Peter, Bob, Eric, Arnold = Ints('Alice Peter Bob Eric Arnold')
tulips, daffodils, lilies, roses, carnations = Ints('tulips daffodils lilies roses carnations')
Fred, Bella, Timothy, Meredith, Samantha = Ints('Fred Bella Timothy Meredith Samantha')
high_school, bachelor, doctorate, master, associate = Ints('high_school bachelor doctorate master associate')
cat, fish, dog, horse, bird = Ints('cat fish dog horse bird')

all_vars = [Alice, Peter, Bob, Eric, Arnold,
            tulips, daffodils, lilies, roses, carnations,
            Fred, Bella, Timothy, Meredith, Samantha,
            high_school, bachelor, doctorate, master, associate,
            cat, fish, dog, horse, bird]

for v in all_vars:
    s.add(1 <= v, v <= 5)

names = [Alice, Peter, Bob, Eric, Arnold]
flowers = [tulips, daffodils, lilies, roses, carnations]
children = [Fred, Bella, Timothy, Meredith, Samantha]
educations = [high_school, bachelor, doctorate, master, associate]
animals = [cat, fish, dog, horse, bird]

for group in [names, flowers, children, educations, animals]:
    s.add(Distinct(*group))

s.add(Peter > dog)
s.add(one_house_between(carnations, bachelor))
s.add(one_house_between(doctorate, cat))
s.add(associate + 1 == tulips)
s.add(one_house_between(cat, horse))
s.add(Fred < bachelor)
s.add(Meredith != 3)
s.add(master == Bella)
s.add(bachelor == Bob)
s.add(Timothy == daffodils)
s.add(Samantha == Bob)
s.add(Arnold + 1 == Peter)
s.add(bird + 1 == daffodils)
s.add(roses == bird)
s.add(one_house_between(dog, fish))
s.add(tulips == Eric)

if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()

    def lookup(items, pos):
        for var, label in items:
            if m.eval(var).as_long() == pos:
                return label
        return "?"

    name_items = [(Alice, "Alice"), (Peter, "Peter"), (Bob, "Bob"), (Eric, "Eric"), (Arnold, "Arnold")]
    flower_items = [(tulips, "tulips"), (daffodils, "daffodils"), (lilies, "lilies"), (roses, "roses"), (carnations, "carnations")]
    child_items = [(Fred, "Fred"), (Bella, "Bella"), (Timothy, "Timothy"), (Meredith, "Meredith"), (Samantha, "Samantha")]
    edu_items = [(high_school, "high school"), (bachelor, "bachelor"), (doctorate, "doctorate"), (master, "master"), (associate, "associate")]
    animal_items = [(cat, "cat"), (fish, "fish"), (dog, "dog"), (horse, "horse"), (bird, "bird")]

    for h in range(1, 6):
        name = lookup(name_items, h)
        flower = lookup(flower_items, h)
        child = lookup(child_items, h)
        edu = lookup(edu_items, h)
        animal = lookup(animal_items, h)
        print("House {}: {}, {}, {}, {}, {}".format(h, name, flower, child, edu, animal))
else:
    print("No solution")

from z3 import *

solver = Solver()

person_names = ["Bob", "Peter", "Eric", "Alice", "Arnold"]
child_names = ["Timothy", "Meredith", "Fred", "Bella", "Samantha"]

name = {n: Int(f"name_{n}") for n in person_names}
child = {n: Int(f"child_{n}") for n in child_names}

for v in list(name.values()) + list(child.values()):

solver.add(name["Eric"] == child["Timothy"])
solver.add(child["Samantha"] > child["Meredith"])
solver.add(name["Bob"] + 1 == name["Arnold"])
solver.add(child["Meredith"] > child["Fred"])
solver.add(name["Bob"] == child["Fred"])
solver.add(name["Peter"] == child["Meredith"])

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()
    for house in range(1, 6):
        person = next(p for p in person_names if model.eval(name[p], model_completion=True).as_long() == house)
        child_at_house = next(c for c in child_names if model.eval(child[c], model_completion=True).as_long() == house)
        print(f"House {house}: {person}, {child_at_house}")
else:
    print("unsat")
```

from z3 import *

solver = Solver()

person_names = ["Bob", "Peter", "Eric", "Alice", "Arnold"]
child_names = ["Timothy", "Meredith", "Fred", "Bella", "Samantha"]

name = {n: Int(f"name_{n}") for n in person_names}
child = {n: Int(f"child_{n}") for n in child_names}

for v in list(name.values()) + list(child.values()):
    solver.add(v >= 1, v <= 5)

solver.add(Distinct(*name.values()))
solver.add(Distinct(*child.values()))

solver.add(child["Timothy"] + 1 == child["Meredith"])
solver.add(name["Eric"] == child["Timothy"])
solver.add(child["Samantha"] > child["Meredith"])
solver.add(name["Bob"] + 1 == name["Arnold"])
solver.add(child["Meredith"] > child["Fred"])
solver.add(name["Bob"] == child["Fred"])
solver.add(name["Peter"] == child["Meredith"])

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()
    person_at = {model.eval(name[n], model_completion=True).as_long(): n for n in person_names}
    child_at = {model.eval(child[c], model_completion=True).as_long(): c for c in child_names}
    for house in range(1, 6):
        print(f"House {house}: {person_at[house]}, {child_at[house]}")
else:
    print("unsat")
```

from z3 import *

solver = Solver()

# Position variables are house numbers 1..3.
Eric, Peter, Arnold = Ints('Eric Peter Arnold')
swede, dane, brit = Ints('swede dane brit')
blonde, brown, black = Ints('blonde brown black')
cooking, gardening, photography = Ints('cooking gardening photography')

all_vars = [Eric, Peter, Arnold, swede, dane, brit, blonde, brown, black, cooking, gardening, photography]

for v in all_vars:
    solver.add(v >= 1, v <= 3)

# Unique attributes within each category.
solver.add(Distinct(Eric, Peter, Arnold))
solver.add(Distinct(swede, dane, brit))
solver.add(Distinct(blonde, brown, black))
solver.add(Distinct(cooking, gardening, photography))

# Clue 1: The Dane is the person who enjoys gardening.
solver.add(dane == gardening)

# Clue 2: Blonde hair and the British person are next to each other.
solver.add(Or(blonde - brit == 1, brit - blonde == 1))

# Clue 3: Arnold is somewhere to the left of the person who has black hair.
solver.add(Arnold < black)

# Clue 4: The Swedish person is Arnold.
solver.add(swede == Arnold)

# Clue 5: The photography enthusiast is not in the third house.
solver.add(photography != 3)

# Clue 6: The person who has brown hair is not in the third house.
solver.add(brown != 3)

# Clue 7: The person who has blonde hair is not in the third house.
solver.add(blonde != 3)

# Clue 8: The photography enthusiast is Eric.
solver.add(photography == Eric)

# Clue 9: The Swedish person is not in the second house.
solver.add(swede != 2)

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()

    name_vars = [(Eric, "Eric"), (Peter, "Peter"), (Arnold, "Arnold")]
    nationality_vars = [(swede, "swede"), (dane, "dane"), (brit, "brit")]
    hair_vars = [(blonde, "blonde"), (brown, "brown"), (black, "black")]
    hobby_vars = [(cooking, "cooking"), (gardening, "gardening"), (photography, "photography")]

    categories = [name_vars, nationality_vars, hair_vars, hobby_vars]

    for house in range(1, 4):
        row = []
        for category in categories:
            for var, label in category:
                if model.eval(var).as_long() == house:
                    row.append(label)
                    break
        print("House {}: {}".format(house, ", ".join(row)))

```python
from z3 import *

def main():
    solver = Solver()

    Alice, Peter, Arnold, Eric = Ints("Alice Peter Arnold Eric")
    grilled_cheese, spaghetti, pizza, stew = Ints("grilled_cheese spaghetti pizza stew")

    name_vars = {
        "Alice": Alice,
        "Peter": Peter,
        "Arnold": Arnold,
        "Eric": Eric,
    }
    food_vars = {
        "grilled cheese": grilled_cheese,
        "spaghetti": spaghetti,
        "pizza": pizza,
        "stew": stew,
    }

    for var in list(name_vars.values()) + list(food_vars.values()):
        solver.add(var >= 1)
        solver.add(var <= 4)

    solver.add(Distinct(Alice, Peter, Arnold, Eric))
    solver.add(Distinct(grilled_cheese, spaghetti, pizza, stew))

    # Clue 1 & 2: Arnold has grilled cheese, and grilled cheese is in house 3.
    solver.add(Arnold == grilled_cheese)
    solver.add(grilled_cheese == 3)

    # Clue 3 & 5: stew is not in houses 2 or 4.
    solver.add(stew != 2)
    solver.add(stew != 4)

    # Clue 4: Peter is to the right of the person with spaghetti.
    solver.add(Peter > spaghetti)

    # Clue 6: Eric is the person with spaghetti.
    solver.add(Eric == spaghetti)

    if solver.check() != sat:
        print("unsat")
        return

    model = solver.model()

    name_by_house = {model.eval(var).as_long(): label for label, var in name_vars.items()}
    food_by_house = {model.eval(var).as_long(): label for label, var in food_vars.items()}

    for house in range(1, 5):
        print(f"House {house}: {name_by_house[house]}, {food_by_house[house]}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

from z3 import *

def main():
    solver = Solver()

    # House positions for names
    Alice, Peter, Arnold, Eric = Ints("Alice Peter Arnold Eric")
    # House positions for lunch items
    grilled_cheese, spaghetti, pizza, stew = Ints("grilled_cheese spaghetti pizza stew")

    name_vars = {
        "Alice": Alice,
        "Peter": Peter,
        "Arnold": Arnold,
        "Eric": Eric,
    }
    food_vars = {
        "grilled cheese": grilled_cheese,
        "spaghetti": spaghetti,
        "pizza": pizza,
        "stew": stew,
    }

    for var in list(name_vars.values()) + list(food_vars.values()):
        solver.add(var >= 1, var <= 4)

    solver.add(Distinct(Alice, Peter, Arnold, Eric))
    solver.add(Distinct(grilled_cheese, spaghetti, pizza, stew))

    # Clue 1 and 2: Arnold is in house 3 and has grilled cheese.
    solver.add(Arnold == grilled_cheese)
    solver.add(grilled_cheese == 3)

    # Clue 3 and 5: stew is not in house 2 or house 4.
    solver.add(stew != 2)
    solver.add(stew != 4)

    # Clue 4: Peter is to the right of the spaghetti eater.
    solver.add(Peter > spaghetti)

    # Clue 6: Eric is the spaghetti eater.
    solver.add(Eric == spaghetti)

    if solver.check() != sat:
        print("unsat")
        return

    model = solver.model()

    name_by_house = {model.eval(var).as_long(): label for label, var in name_vars.items()}
    food_by_house = {model.eval(var).as_long(): label for label, var in food_vars.items()}

    for house in range(1, 5):
        print(f"House {house}: {name_by_house[house]}, {food_by_house[house]}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```python
from z3 import *

solver = Solver()

# Each attribute value is represented by its house number.
eric, arnold = Ints('eric arnold')
tea, water = Ints('tea water')
high_school, associate = Ints('high_school associate')
beach, mountain = Ints('beach mountain')

all_vars = [eric, arnold, tea, water, high_school, associate, beach, mountain]
for v in all_vars:
    solver.add(v >= 1, v <= 2)

# Unique assignment for each characteristic.
solver.add(Distinct(eric, arnold))
solver.add(Distinct(tea, water))
solver.add(Distinct(high_school, associate))
solver.add(Distinct(beach, mountain))

# Every house has exactly one value from each characteristic.
for h in range(1, 3):
    solver.add(Or(eric == h, arnold == h))
    solver.add(Or(tea == h, water == h))
    solver.add(Or(high_school == h, associate == h))
    solver.add(Or(beach == h, mountain == h))

# Clue 1: mountain is right of associate.
solver.add(mountain > associate)

# Clue 2: water drinker is Eric.
solver.add(water == eric)

# Clue 3: water drinker is right of beach vacationer.
solver.add(water > beach)

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()

    def house_of(var):
        return model.eval(var).as_long()

    name_items = [("Eric", eric), ("Arnold", arnold)]
    drink_items = [("tea", tea), ("water", water)]
    education_items = [("high school", high_school), ("associate", associate)]
    vacation_items = [("beach", beach), ("mountain", mountain)]

    for house_no in range(1, 3):
        name = next(label for label, var in name_items if house_of(var) == house_no)
        drink = next(label for label, var in drink_items if house_of(var) == house_no)
        education = next(label for label, var in education_items if house_of(var) == house_no)
        vacation = next(label for label, var in vacation_items if house_of(var) == house_no)
        print(f"House {house_no}: {name}, {drink}, {education}, {vacation}")
else:
    print("unsat")
```

```python
from z3 import *

solver = Solver()

# Attribute values are represented by house positions.
eric, arnold = Ints('eric arnold')
tea, water = Ints('tea water')
high_school, associate = Ints('high_school associate')
beach, mountain = Ints('beach mountain')

all_attributes = [eric, arnold, tea, water, high_school, associate, beach, mountain]
for a in all_attributes:
    solver.add(a >= 1, a <= 2)

# Uniqueness within each characteristic.
solver.add(Distinct(eric, arnold))
solver.add(Distinct(tea, water))
solver.add(Distinct(high_school, associate))
solver.add(Distinct(beach, mountain))

# Every house gets exactly one value from each characteristic.
for h in range(1, 3):
    solver.add(Or(eric == h, arnold == h))
    solver.add(Or(tea == h, water == h))
    solver.add(Or(high_school == h, associate == h))
    solver.add(Or(beach == h, mountain == h))

# Clue 1: mountain is to the right of associate.
solver.add(mountain > associate)

# Clue 2: water drinker is Eric.
solver.add(water == eric)

# Clue 3: water drinker is to the right of beach vacationer.
solver.add(water > beach)

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()

    def pos(v):
        return model.eval(v).as_long()

    names = [("Eric", eric), ("Arnold", arnold)]
    drinks = [("tea", tea), ("water", water)]
    educations = [("high school", high_school), ("associate", associate)]
    vacations = [("beach", beach), ("mountain", mountain)]

    for house_no in range(1, 3):
        name = next(label for label, v in names if pos(v) == house_no)
        drink = next(label for label, v in drinks if pos(v) == house_no)
        education = next(label for label, v in educations if pos(v) == house_no)
        vacation = next(label for label, v in vacations if pos(v) == house_no)
        print(f"House {house_no}: {name}, {drink}, {education}, {vacation}")
else:
    print("unsat")
```

examples.extracted_code:
from z3 import *

solver = Solver()

# Attribute values are represented by their house positions.
eric, arnold = Ints('eric arnold')
tea, water = Ints('tea water')
high_school, associate = Ints('high_school associate')
beach, mountain = Ints('beach mountain')

all_attributes = [eric, arnold, tea, water, high_school, associate, beach, mountain]

for v in all_attributes:
    solver.add(v >= 1)
    solver.add(v <= 2)

# Each characteristic has unique values.
solver.add(Distinct(eric, arnold))
solver.add(Distinct(tea, water))
solver.add(Distinct(high_school, associate))
solver.add(Distinct(beach, mountain))

# Every house has exactly one value from each characteristic.
for house_no in range(1, 3):
    solver.add(Or(eric == house_no, arnold == house_no))
    solver.add(Or(tea == house_no, water == house_no))
    solver.add(Or(high_school == house_no, associate == house_no))
    solver.add(Or(beach == house_no, mountain == house_no))

# Clue 1: mountain retreats are to the right of associate's degree.
solver.add(mountain > associate)

# Clue 2: the water drinker is Eric.
solver.add(water == eric)

# Clue 3: the water drinker is to the right of beach vacations.
solver.add(water > beach)

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()

    def position(var):
        return model.eval(var).as_long()

    name_items = [("Eric", eric), ("Arnold", arnold)]
    drink_items = [("tea", tea), ("water", water)]
    education_items = [("high school", high_school), ("associate", associate)]
    vacation_items = [("beach", beach), ("mountain", mountain)]

    for house_no in range(1, 3):
        name = next(label for label, var in name_items if position(var) == house_no)
        drink = next(label for label, var in drink_items if position(var) == house_no)
        education = next(label for label, var in education_items if position(var) == house_no)
        vacation = next(label for label, var in vacation_items if position(var) == house_no)
        print(f"House {house_no}: {name}, {drink}, {education}, {vacation}")
else:
    print("unsat")

from z3 import *

s = Solver()

Eric, Arnold, Peter = Ints('Eric Arnold Peter')
Dog, Fish, Cat = Ints('Dog Fish Cat')
Mystery, Romance, ScienceFiction = Ints('Mystery Romance ScienceFiction')
FordF150, TeslaModel3, ToyotaCamry = Ints('FordF150 TeslaModel3 ToyotaCamry')
April, Jan, September = Ints('April Jan September')
Rock, Classical, Pop = Ints('Rock Classical Pop')

all_vars = [
    Eric, Arnold, Peter,
    Dog, Fish, Cat,
    Mystery, Romance, ScienceFiction,
    FordF150, TeslaModel3, ToyotaCamry,
    April, Jan, September,
    Rock, Classical, Pop
]

for v in all_vars:
    s.add(v >= 0)
    s.add(v <= 2)

s.add(Distinct(Eric, Arnold, Peter))
s.add(Distinct(Dog, Fish, Cat))
s.add(Distinct(Mystery, Romance, ScienceFiction))
s.add(Distinct(FordF150, TeslaModel3, ToyotaCamry))
s.add(Distinct(April, Jan, September))
s.add(Distinct(Rock, Classical, Pop))

s.add(Romance + 1 == FordF150)
s.add(September == ToyotaCamry)
s.add(September == Peter)
s.add(TeslaModel3 == Jan)
s.add(Fish != 1)
s.add(Arnold == Cat)
s.add(TeslaModel3 == ScienceFiction)
s.add(ScienceFiction != 2)
s.add(FordF150 == Pop)
s.add(Rock + 1 == Eric)

if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()

    def value(pairs, house):
        for var, label in pairs:
            if m[var].as_long() == house:
                return label
        return "?"

    names = [(Eric, "Eric"), (Arnold, "Arnold"), (Peter, "Peter")]
    pets = [(Dog, "dog"), (Fish, "fish"), (Cat, "cat")]
    books = [(Mystery, "mystery"), (Romance, "romance"), (ScienceFiction, "science fiction")]
    cars = [(FordF150, "ford f150"), (TeslaModel3, "tesla model 3"), (ToyotaCamry, "toyota camry")]
    months = [(April, "april"), (Jan, "jan"), (September, "sept")]
    musics = [(Rock, "rock"), (Classical, "classical"), (Pop, "pop")]

    for house in range(3):
        print(
            f"House {house + 1}: "
            f"{value(names, house)}, "
            f"{value(pets, house)}, "
            f"{value(books, house)}, "
            f"{value(cars, house)}, "
            f"{value(months, house)}, "
            f"{value(musics, house)}"
        )
else:
    print("unsat")

from z3 import *

def solve():
    solver = Solver()

    # Person variables: house number (1-4)
    eric = Int('Eric')
    arnold = Int('Arnold')
    alice = Int('Alice')
    peter = Int('Peter')

    # Lunch variables: house number
    pizza = Int('pizza')
    spaghetti = Int('spaghetti')
    grilled_cheese = Int('grilled_cheese')
    stew = Int('stew')

    # Music variables: house number
    pop = Int('pop')
    classical = Int('classical')
    jazz = Int('jazz')
    rock = Int('rock')

    people = [eric, arnold, alice, peter]
    lunches = [pizza, spaghetti, grilled_cheese, stew]
    musics = [pop, classical, jazz, rock]

    for group in (people, lunches, musics):
        for v in group:
            solver.add(v >= 1, v <= 4)
        solver.add(Distinct(group))

    # Clue 1
    solver.add(rock == 3)
    # Clue 2
    solver.add(peter != 2)
    # Clue 3
    solver.add(pizza != 1)
    # Clue 4
    solver.add(spaghetti == 4)
    # Clue 5
    solver.add(arnold == 3)
    # Clue 6
    solver.add(eric == 4)
    # Clue 7
    solver.add(peter == pop)
    # Clue 8
    solver.add(classical == stew)

    if solver.check() == sat:
        model = solver.model()

        person_names = ["Eric", "Arnold", "Alice", "Peter"]
        lunch_names = ["pizza", "spaghetti", "grilled cheese", "stew"]
        music_names = ["pop", "classical", "jazz", "rock"]

        for house in range(1, 5):
            person = next(name for name, var in zip(person_names, people) if model.eval(var).as_long() == house)
            lunch = next(name for name, var in zip(lunch_names, lunches) if model.eval(var).as_long() == house)
            music = next(name for name, var in zip(music_names, musics) if model.eval(var).as_long() == house)
            print(f"House {house}: {person}, {lunch}, {music}")
    else:
        print("unsat")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

s = Solver()

engineer, lawyer, nurse, doctor, artist, teacher = Ints("engineer lawyer nurse doctor artist teacher")

positions = [
    Alice, Peter, Arnold, Bob, Carol, Eric,
    red, brown, blonde, black, gray, auburn,
    engineer, lawyer, nurse, doctor, artist, teacher
]
for p in positions:
    s.add(p >= 1, p <= 6)

s.add(Distinct(Alice, Peter, Arnold, Bob, Carol, Eric))
s.add(Distinct(red, brown, blonde, black, gray, auburn))
s.add(Distinct(engineer, lawyer, nurse, doctor, artist, teacher))

def adjacent(a, b):
    return Or(a == b + 1, b == a + 1)

s.add(Bob + 1 == teacher)

s.add(doctor > red)
s.add(adjacent(brown, Carol))
s.add(Arnold < doctor)

    m = s.model()
    name_items = [("Alice", Alice), ("Peter", Peter), ("Arnold", Arnold), ("Bob", Bob), ("Carol", Carol), ("Eric", Eric)]
    color_items = [("red", red), ("brown", brown), ("blonde", blonde), ("black", black), ("gray", gray), ("auburn", auburn)]

        print(f"House {h}: {name}, {color}, {job}")

cat = Int("cat")

city = Int("city")

camping = Int("camping")

samsung_galaxy_s21 = Int("samsung_galaxy_s21")
iphone_13 = Int("iphone_13")
oneplus_9 = Int("oneplus_9")

solver = Solver()

all_vars = [
    peter, eric, alice, arnold, bob,
    fish, dog, bird, cat, horse,
    beach, city, mountain, camping, cruise,
    google_pixel_6, huawei_p50, samsung_galaxy_s21, iphone_13, oneplus_9,

for v in all_vars:

solver.add(Distinct(fish, dog, bird, cat, horse))
solver.add(Distinct(beach, city, mountain, camping, cruise))
solver.add(Distinct(google_pixel_6, huawei_p50, samsung_galaxy_s21, iphone_13, oneplus_9))

def diff_abs(a, b):
    return If(a > b, a - b, b - a)

solver.add(alice != 5)
solver.add(arnold != 5)
solver.add(oneplus_9 == mountain)
solver.add(bob == beach)
solver.add(cat == 2)

        ("Alice", alice),
        ("Arnold", arnold),
        ("Bob", bob),
    ]
    animal_items = [
        ("fish", fish),
        ("dog", dog),
        ("bird", bird),
        ("cat", cat),
        ("horse", horse),

from z3 import *

names = ["Peter", "Arnold", "Bob", "Alice", "Eric", "Carol"]
mothers = ["Holly", "Aniya", "Kailyn", "Janelle", "Penny", "Sarah"]
lunches = ["stir fry", "stew", "spaghetti", "soup", "pizza", "grilled cheese"]
animals = ["dog", "horse", "cat", "fish", "rabbit", "bird"]
smoothies = ["watermelon", "desert", "lime", "cherry", "blueberry", "dragonfruit"]
styles = ["mediterranean", "craftsman", "victorian", "colonial", "modern", "ranch"]

def make_vars(category, values):
    return {value: Int(f"{category}_{value.replace(' ', '_').replace('-', '_')}") for value in values}

person = make_vars("person", names)
mother = make_vars("mother", mothers)
lunch = make_vars("lunch", lunches)
animal = make_vars("animal", animals)
smoothie = make_vars("smoothie", smoothies)
style = make_vars("style", styles)

s = Solver()

for group in [person, mother, lunch, animal, smoothie, style]:
    s.add(Distinct(list(group.values())))
    for var in group.values():
        s.add(var >= 1, var <= 6)

def exactly_gap(a, b, gap):
    s.add(Or(a - b == gap, b - a == gap))

s.add(mother["Penny"] == style["victorian"])
s.add(style["modern"] == mother["Kailyn"])
s.add(style["modern"] > style["victorian"])
s.add(smoothie["blueberry"] != 6)

s.add(smoothie["cherry"] != 3)

from z3 import *

arnold, peter, eric = Ints('arnold peter eric')
samsung, iphone, google = Ints('samsung iphone google')
doctor, teacher, engineer = Ints('doctor teacher engineer')
photography, cooking, gardening = Ints('photography cooking gardening')
bird, horse, cat = Ints('bird horse cat')

solver = Solver()

all_vars = [
    arnold, peter, eric,
    samsung, iphone, google,
    doctor, teacher, engineer,
    photography, cooking, gardening,
    bird, horse, cat
]
for v in all_vars:
    solver.add(v >= 1)
    solver.add(v <= 3)

solver.add(Distinct(arnold, peter, eric))
solver.add(Distinct(samsung, iphone, google))
solver.add(Distinct(doctor, teacher, engineer))
solver.add(Distinct(photography, cooking, gardening))
solver.add(Distinct(bird, horse, cat))

solver.add(samsung + 1 == teacher)
solver.add(Or(samsung - arnold == 1, arnold - samsung == 1))
solver.add(engineer == horse)
solver.add(iphone == cat)
solver.add(bird == samsung)
solver.add(cooking != 3)
solver.add(gardening + 1 == teacher)
solver.add(Or(eric - iphone == 2, iphone - eric == 2))

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()

    names = {"Arnold": arnold, "Peter": peter, "Eric": eric}
    phones = {"samsung galaxy s21": samsung, "iphone 13": iphone, "google pixel 6": google}
    occupations = {"doctor": doctor, "teacher": teacher, "engineer": engineer}
    hobbies = {"photography": photography, "cooking": cooking, "gardening": gardening}
    animals = {"bird": bird, "horse": horse, "cat": cat}

    def category_value(category, house):
        for label, var in category.items():
            if model.eval(var).as_long() == house:
                return label

    for house in range(1, 4):
        print(
            f"House {house}: "
            f"{category_value(names, house)}, "
            f"{category_value(phones, house)}, "
            f"{category_value(occupations, house)}, "
            f"{category_value(hobbies, house)}, "
            f"{category_value(animals, house)}"
        )

from z3 import *

s = Solver()

brit = Int('brit')
dane = Int('dane')
yellow = Int('yellow')
red = Int('red')
Aniya = Int('Aniya')
Holly = Int('Holly')

categories = [

    ("Nationality", [("brit", brit), ("dane", dane)]),
    ("Favorite Color", [("yellow", yellow), ("red", red)]),
    ("Mother", [("Aniya", Aniya), ("Holly", Holly)])
]

s.add(red == Arnold)
s.add(Holly + 1 == brit)
s.add(Holly == cat)

if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    def house_of(var):
        return m.eval(var, model_completion=True).as_long()
    for h in [1, 2]:
        row = [f"House {h}"]
        for _, entries in categories:
            for label, var in entries:
                if house_of(var) == h:
                    row.append(label)
                    break

else:

```

yellow = Int('yellow')

Aniya = Int('Aniya')
Holly = Int('Holly')

categories = [
    ("Name", [("Arnold", Arnold), ("Eric", Eric)]),

    ("Pet", [("cat", cat), ("dog", dog)]),
    ("Nationality", [("brit", brit), ("dane", dane)]),

]

s.add(Holly == cat)

    m = s.model()

        return m.eval(var, model_completion=True).as_long()

    for h in (1, 2):

from z3 import *

grilled_cheese = Int("grilled_cheese")

solver = Solver()

# Clue 2
solver.add(Eric == 4)
# Clue 3 + Clue 5: Peter is the person who loves spaghetti; Arnold is to the right of that person.

# Clue 4
solver.add(stew == 2)
# Clue 5
solver.add(Peter == spaghetti)
# Clue 6
solver.add(grilled_cheese == 4)

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()

    name_by_house = {}
    lunch_by_house = {}

    name_labels = {
        Arnold: "Arnold",
        Peter: "Peter",
        Eric: "Eric",
        Alice: "Alice",
    }
    lunch_labels = {
        pizza: "pizza",
        grilled_cheese: "grilled cheese",
        spaghetti: "spaghetti",
        stew: "stew",
    }

    for var, label in name_labels.items():

    for var, label in lunch_labels.items():

    for house in range(1, 5):
        print(f"House {house}: {name_by_house[house]}, {lunch_by_house[house]}")
else:
    print("unsat")
```

```python
from z3 import *

# Variables
people = Ints('Arnold Peter Bob Eric Alice')
Arnold, Peter, Bob, Eric, Alice = people

hair_colors = Ints('gray brown black red blonde')
gray, brown, black, red, blonde = hair_colors

vacations = Ints('city mountain camping cruise beach')
city, mountain, camping, cruise, beach = vacations

flowers = Ints('roses tulips carnations lilies daffodils')
roses, tulips, carnations, lilies, daffodils = flowers

lunches = Ints('stew stir_fry spaghetti pizza grilled_cheese')
stew, stir_fry, spaghetti, pizza, grilled_cheese = lunches

hobbies = Ints('painting photography gardening knitting cooking')
painting, photography, gardening, knitting, cooking = hobbies

s = Solver()

for group in [people, hair_colors, vacations, flowers, lunches, hobbies]:
    s.add(Distinct(group))
    for v in group:
        s.add(v >= 1, v <= 5)

# Clues
s.add(stew + 1 == tulips)
s.add(camping == grilled_cheese)
s.add(black < Bob)
s.add(photography == gray)
s.add(pizza == cruise)
s.add(Alice == city)
s.add(beach + 1 == painting)
s.add(spaghetti == Arnold)
s.add(Bob == 5)
s.add(lilies == 3)
s.add(knitting == 4)
s.add(brown + 1 == painting)
s.add(Or(cruise + 3 == knitting, knitting + 3 == cruise))
s.add(red == spaghetti)
s.add(carnations != 2)
s.add(Eric < gardening)
s.add(photography == stew)
s.add(Eric == daffodils)

if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()

    def house(var):
        return m.eval(var, model_completion=True).as_long()

    def display(var):
        return str(var).replace('_', ' ')

    for h in range(1, 6):
        name = next(v for v in people if house(v) == h)
        color = next(v for v in hair_colors if house(v) == h)
        vacation = next(v for v in vacations if house(v) == h)
        flower = next(v for v in flowers if house(v) == h)
        lunch = next(v for v in lunches if house(v) == h)
        hobby = next(v for v in hobbies if house(v) == h)
        print(f"House {h}: {display(name)}, {display(color)}, {display(vacation)}, {display(flower)}, {display(lunch)}, {display(hobby)}")
else:
    print("No solution")
```

from z3 import *

people = Ints('Arnold Peter Bob Eric Alice')
Arnold, Peter, Bob, Eric, Alice = people

hair_colors = Ints('gray brown black red blonde')
gray, brown, black, red, blonde = hair_colors

city, mountain, camping, cruise, beach = vacations

flowers = Ints('roses tulips carnations lilies daffodils')
roses, tulips, carnations, lilies, daffodils = flowers

lunches = Ints('stew stir_fry spaghetti pizza grilled_cheese')
stew, stir_fry, spaghetti, pizza, grilled_cheese = lunches

hobbies = Ints('painting photography gardening knitting cooking')
painting, photography, gardening, knitting, cooking = hobbies

s = Solver()

for group in [people, hair_colors, vacations, flowers, lunches, hobbies]:
    s.add(Distinct(*group))
    for v in group:
        s.add(v >= 1, v <= 5)

s.add(camping == grilled_cheese)
s.add(black < Bob)

s.add(carnations != 2)
s.add(Eric < gardening)
s.add(photography == stew)
s.add(Eric == daffodils)

    def house_position(v):

        lunch = next(v for v in lunches if house_position(v) == h)
        hobby = next(v for v in hobbies if house_position(v) == h)
        print(f"House {h}: {display_name(name)}, {display_name(color)}, {display_name(vacation)}, {display_name(flower)}, {display_name(lunch)}, {display_name(hobby)}")

persons = [Eric, Peter, Arnold, Alice]

smoothies = [cherry, desert, dragonfruit, watermelon]

for v in persons + lunches + drinks + smoothies:
    solver.add(And(v >= 1, v <= 4))

solver.add(Distinct(*persons))
solver.add(Distinct(*lunches))
solver.add(Distinct(*drinks))
solver.add(Distinct(*smoothies))

solver.add(dragonfruit == milk)
solver.add(watermelon != 4)
solver.add(grilled_cheese + 1 == Peter)

        "Arnold": "Arnold",
        "Alice": "Alice",
        "spaghetti": "spaghetti",

from z3 import *

ARNOLD, ERIC, PETER = 0, 1, 2
PIXEL, SAMSUNG, IPHONE = 0, 1, 2

name = [Int(f"name_{i}") for i in range(3)]
phone = [Int(f"phone_{i}") for i in range(3)]

solver = Solver()

# Domains
for i in range(3):
    solver.add(name[i] >= 0, name[i] <= 2)
    solver.add(phone[i] >= 0, phone[i] <= 2)

# Each name and phone model is used exactly once
solver.add(Distinct(*name))

for value in range(3):
    solver.add(Or(*[name[i] == value for i in range(3)]))
    solver.add(Or(*[phone[i] == value for i in range(3)]))

# Clue 1: Eric is not in house 1
solver.add(name[0] != ERIC)

# Clue 2: Eric uses Google Pixel 6
solver.add(Or(*[And(name[i] == ERIC, phone[i] == PIXEL) for i in range(3)]))

# Clue 3: Eric is left of Peter
solver.add(Or(*[And(name[i] == ERIC, name[j] == PETER)
                 for i in range(3) for j in range(i+1, 3)]))

# Clue 4: Peter uses iPhone 13
solver.add(Or(*[And(name[i] == PETER, phone[i] == IPHONE) for i in range(3)]))

    model = solver.model()
    name_map = {ARNOLD: "Arnold", ERIC: "Eric", PETER: "Peter"}

from z3 import *

ARNOLD, ERIC, PETER = 0, 1, 2
PIXEL, SAMSUNG, IPHONE = 0, 1, 2

name = [Int(f"name_{i}") for i in range(3)]
phone = [Int(f"phone_{i}") for i in range(3)]

solver = Solver()

# House positions: 0, 1, 2 correspond to houses 1, 2, 3.
# Name/phone values are encoded as small integers; maps later translate them.

    solver.add(name[i] >= 0, name[i] <= 2)
    solver.add(phone[i] >= 0, phone[i] <= 2)

# Each name and each phone model is unique.
solver.add(Distinct(*name))
solver.add(Distinct(*phone))

# Clue 1: Eric is not in the first house.
solver.add(name[0] != ERIC)

# Clue 2: Eric is the person who uses a Google Pixel 6.
solver.add(Or(*[And(name[i] == ERIC, phone[i] == PIXEL) for i in range(3)]))

# Clue 3: Eric is somewhere to the left of Peter.
solver.add(Or(*[And(name[i] == ERIC, name[j] == PETER)
                 for i in range(3) for j in range(i + 1, 3)]))

# Clue 4: Peter is the person who uses an iPhone 13.
solver.add(Or(*[And(name[i] == PETER, phone[i] == IPHONE) for i in range(3)]))

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()
    name_map = {ARNOLD: "Arnold", ERIC: "Eric", PETER: "Peter"}
    phone_map = {PIXEL: "google pixel 6", SAMSUNG: "samsung galaxy s21", IPHONE: "iphone 13"}

    for i in range(3):
        n = model.eval(name[i]).as_long()
        p = model.eval(phone[i]).as_long()
        print(f"House {i + 1}: {name_map[n]}, {phone_map[p]}")
```

from z3 import *

solver = Solver()

Arnold, Alice, Eric, Peter = Ints('Arnold Alice Eric Peter')
spaghetti, stew, pizza, grilled_cheese = Ints('spaghetti stew pizza grilled_cheese')
fish, horse, bird, cat = Ints('fish horse bird cat')

all_vars = [
    Arnold, Alice, Eric, Peter,
    spaghetti, stew, pizza, grilled_cheese,
    fish, horse, bird, cat
]

for v in all_vars:
    solver.add(v >= 1, v <= 4)

solver.add(Distinct(Arnold, Alice, Eric, Peter))
solver.add(Distinct(spaghetti, stew, pizza, grilled_cheese))
solver.add(Distinct(fish, horse, bird, cat))

# Clue 1: The fish enthusiast is Alice.
solver.add(fish == Alice)

# Clue 2: Eric is in the second house.
solver.add(Eric == 2)

# Clue 3: Pizza lover is directly left of the fish enthusiast.
solver.add(pizza + 1 == fish)

# Clue 4: Arnold is the bird keeper.
solver.add(Arnold == bird)

# Clue 5: Grilled cheese lover is Peter.
solver.add(grilled_cheese == Peter)

# Clue 6: Cat lover and stew lover are next to each other.
solver.add(Or(cat == stew + 1, cat == stew - 1))

# Clue 7: Pizza lover is somewhere to the right of Eric.
solver.add(pizza > Eric)

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()

    name_by_house = {}
    for var in [Arnold, Alice, Eric, Peter]:
        house = model.eval(var).as_long()
        name_by_house[house] = var.decl().name()

    lunch_by_house = {}
    for var in [spaghetti, stew, pizza, grilled_cheese]:
        house = model.eval(var).as_long()
        lunch_by_house[house] = var.decl().name().replace('_', ' ')

    animal_by_house = {}
    for var in [fish, horse, bird, cat]:
        house = model.eval(var).as_long()
        animal_by_house[house] = var.decl().name()

    for house in range(1, 5):
        print(f"House {house}: {name_by_house[house]}, {lunch_by_house[house]}, {animal_by_house[house]}")
else:
    print("unsat")

teacher = Int('teacher')

occupations = {"doctor": doctor, "teacher": teacher, "engineer": engineer}

solver.add(Distinct(mystery, romance, science_fiction))

from z3 import *

Peter = Int('Peter')
Eric = Int('Eric')
Arnold = Int('Arnold')

toyota_camry = Int('toyota_camry')
tesla_model_3 = Int('tesla_model_3')
ford_f150 = Int('ford_f150')

mystery = Int('mystery')
romance = Int('romance')
science_fiction = Int('science_fiction')

doctor = Int('doctor')
teacher = Int('teacher')
engineer = Int('engineer')

names = {"Peter": Peter, "Eric": Eric, "Arnold": Arnold}
cars = {"toyota camry": toyota_camry, "tesla model 3": tesla_model_3, "ford f150": ford_f150}
genres = {"mystery": mystery, "romance": romance, "science fiction": science_fiction}
occupations = {"doctor": doctor, "teacher": teacher, "engineer": engineer}

solver = Solver()

all_vars = [
    Peter, Eric, Arnold,
    toyota_camry, tesla_model_3, ford_f150,
    mystery, romance, science_fiction,
    doctor, teacher, engineer
]

for var in all_vars:
    solver.add(var >= 1)
    solver.add(var <= 3)

solver.add(Distinct(Peter, Eric, Arnold))
solver.add(Distinct(toyota_camry, tesla_model_3, ford_f150))
solver.add(Distinct(mystery, romance, science_fiction))
solver.add(Distinct(doctor, teacher, engineer))

solver.add(teacher - science_fiction == 1)
solver.add(Arnold == 3)
solver.add(ford_f150 == teacher)
solver.add(engineer == toyota_camry)
solver.add(engineer > teacher)
solver.add(mystery == teacher)
solver.add(science_fiction == Eric)

if solver.check() == sat:
    m = solver.model()

    def house_number(var):
        return m.eval(var, model_completion=True).as_long()

    def attribute(category, h):
        for label, var in category.items():
            if house_number(var) == h:
                return label

    for h in range(1, 4):
        print(f"House {h}: {attribute(names, h)}, {attribute(cars, h)}, {attribute(genres, h)}, {attribute(occupations, h)}")
