from z3 import *

names = ["Peter", "Bob", "Eric", "Carol", "Alice", "Arnold"]
animals = ["rabbit", "dog", "horse", "fish", "bird", "cat"]
sports = ["basketball", "swimming", "tennis", "soccer", "baseball", "volleyball"]
hair_colors = ["blonde", "gray", "auburn", "red", "black", "brown"]
heights = ["average", "very short", "very tall", "tall", "super tall", "short"]
cigars = ["pall mall", "yellow monster", "blue master", "prince", "dunhill", "blends"]

Name = {n: Int("name_" + n.lower().replace(" ", "_")) for n in names}
Animal = {a: Int("animal_" + a.lower().replace(" ", "_")) for a in animals}
Sport = {sp: Int("sport_" + sp.lower().replace(" ", "_")) for sp in sports}
Hair = {h: Int("hair_" + h.lower().replace(" ", "_")) for h in hair_colors}
Height = {h: Int("height_" + h.lower().replace(" ", "_")) for h in heights}
Cigar = {c: Int("cigar_" + c.lower().replace(" ", "_")) for c in cigars}

solver = Solver()

for mapping in (Name, Animal, Sport, Hair, Height, Cigar):
    for var in mapping.values():
        solver.add(And(var >= 1, var <= 6))
    solver.add(Distinct(list(mapping.values())))

def adjacent(a, b):
    return Or(a - b == 1, b - a == 1)

def one_house_between(a, b):
    return Or(a - b == 2, b - a == 2)

def two_houses_between(a, b):
    return Or(a - b == 3, b - a == 3)

solver.add(adjacent(Height["very tall"], Animal["dog"]))
solver.add(two_houses_between(Sport["tennis"], Height["average"]))
solver.add(Animal["cat"] == Sport["baseball"])
solver.add(Height["very short"] != 5)
solver.add(one_house_between(Animal["fish"], Hair["red"]))
solver.add(Animal["cat"] < Cigar["dunhill"])
solver.add(Animal["rabbit"] < Height["super tall"])
solver.add(Cigar["dunhill"] == Name["Alice"])
solver.add(Hair["red"] == Cigar["dunhill"])
solver.add(Height["super tall"] != 5)
solver.add(Cigar["prince"] < Cigar["yellow monster"])
solver.add(Sport["volleyball"] > Cigar["yellow monster"])
solver.add(Cigar["blue master"] + 1 == Hair["black"])
solver.add(one_house_between(Sport["basketball"], Cigar["blue master"]))
solver.add(Cigar["yellow monster"] == Height["tall"])
solver.add(adjacent(Name["Bob"], Animal["fish"]))
solver.add(Cigar["dunhill"] == Sport["soccer"])
solver.add(Sport["tennis"] != 3)
solver.add(Cigar["blends"] == Name["Arnold"])
solver.add(Cigar["prince"] == Name["Peter"])
solver.add(one_house_between(Hair["blonde"], Height["tall"]))
solver.add(Sport["swimming"] + 1 == Name["Alice"])
solver.add(Height["super tall"] == Name["Eric"])
solver.add(Height["short"] == Animal["rabbit"])
solver.add(Animal["horse"] != 5)
solver.add(adjacent(Animal["cat"], Hair["brown"]))
solver.add(adjacent(Height["short"], Hair["auburn"]))

if solver.check() != sat:
    raise RuntimeError("No solution found")

model = solver.model()

def get_at(m, mapping, house):
    for label, var in mapping.items():
        if m[var].as_long() == house:
            return label
    raise ValueError(f"Missing value at house {house}")

for house in range(1, 7):
    name = get_at(model, Name, house)
    animal = get_at(model, Animal, house)
    sport = get_at(model, Sport, house)
    hair = get_at(model, Hair, house)
    height = get_at(model, Height, house)
    cigar = get_at(model, Cigar, house)
    print(f"House {house}: {name}, {animal}, {sport}, {hair}, {height}, {cigar}")

```python
from z3 import *

name_labels = ["Alice", "Eric", "Bob", "Arnold", "Carol", "Peter"]
hobby_labels = ["gardening", "painting", "knitting", "photography", "cooking", "woodworking"]
car_labels = ["chevrolet silverado", "toyota camry", "bmw 3 series", "ford f150", "honda civic", "tesla model 3"]
style_labels = ["ranch", "colonial", "victorian", "mediterranean", "craftsman", "modern"]

def var(label):
    return Int(label.replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_"))

name_vars = {label: var(label) for label in name_labels}
hobby_vars = {label: var(label) for label in hobby_labels}
car_vars = {label: var(label) for label in car_labels}
style_vars = {label: var(label) for label in style_labels}

s = Solver()

all_vars = list(name_vars.values()) + list(hobby_vars.values()) + list(car_vars.values()) + list(style_vars.values())
for v in all_vars:
    s.add(v >= 1, v <= 6)

s.add(Distinct(*name_vars.values()))
s.add(Distinct(*hobby_vars.values()))
s.add(Distinct(*car_vars.values()))
s.add(Distinct(*style_vars.values()))

def distance(a, b):
    return If(a >= b, a - b, b - a)

s.add(name_vars["Arnold"] > car_vars["bmw 3 series"])
s.add(style_vars["mediterranean"] == hobby_vars["cooking"])
s.add(style_vars["ranch"] == name_vars["Alice"])
s.add(style_vars["victorian"] > name_vars["Eric"])
s.add(name_vars["Arnold"] != 4)
s.add(distance(car_vars["tesla model 3"], hobby_vars["gardening"]) == 2)
s.add(hobby_vars["knitting"] == car_vars["toyota camry"])
s.add(name_vars["Bob"] > style_vars["victorian"])
s.add(distance(hobby_vars["gardening"], name_vars["Arnold"]) == 3)
s.add(car_vars["toyota camry"] != 5)
s.add(name_vars["Alice"] != 3)
s.add(name_vars["Peter"] != 4)
s.add(style_vars["colonial"] == hobby_vars["woodworking"])
s.add(car_vars["ford f150"] == 2)
s.add(distance(hobby_vars["cooking"], hobby_vars["gardening"]) == 1)
s.add(style_vars["ranch"] == car_vars["chevrolet silverado"])
s.add(name_vars["Carol"] < style_vars["ranch"])
s.add(car_vars["toyota camry"] == name_vars["Bob"])
s.add(style_vars["modern"] == hobby_vars["knitting"])
s.add(name_vars["Peter"] != 3)
s.add(distance(hobby_vars["photography"], name_vars["Peter"]) == 1)

if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    category_vars = [name_vars, hobby_vars, car_vars, style_vars]
    for h in range(1, 7):
        attrs = []
        for d in category_vars:
            for label, v in d.items():
                if m[v].as_long() == h:
                    attrs.append(label)
                    break
        print(f"House {h}: " + ", ".join(attrs))
else:
    print("No solution")
```

def var(label):
    return Int(label.replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_"))

from z3 import *

# House positions: 1 = leftmost, 3 = rightmost.
eric, arnold, peter = Ints('eric arnold peter')

bird, horse, cat = Ints('bird horse cat')
doctor, engineer, teacher = Ints('doctor engineer teacher')
jan, sept, april = Ints('jan sept april')
grilled_cheese, pizza, spaghetti = Ints('grilled_cheese pizza spaghetti')

solver = Solver()

all_vars = [
    eric, arnold, peter,
    google_pixel_6, iphone_13, samsung_galaxy_s21,
    bird, horse, cat,
    doctor, engineer, teacher,
    jan, sept, april,
    grilled_cheese, pizza, spaghetti
]

for v in all_vars:
    solver.add(v >= 1, v <= 3)

solver.add(Distinct(bird, horse, cat))
solver.add(Distinct(doctor, engineer, teacher))
solver.add(Distinct(jan, sept, april))
solver.add(Distinct(grilled_cheese, pizza, spaghetti))

# Clue 1: horse owner is directly left of the teacher.
solver.add(horse + 1 == teacher)

# Clue 2 and 6: the spaghetti eater is the engineer and has a January birthday.
solver.add(spaghetti == engineer)
solver.add(spaghetti == jan)

# Clue 3: Samsung Galaxy S21 is not in the third house.
solver.add(samsung_galaxy_s21 != 3)

# Clue 4: the doctor is the cat lover.
solver.add(doctor == cat)

# Clue 5: the iPhone 13 is Peter.
solver.add(iphone_13 == peter)

# Clue 7: Samsung Galaxy S21 user loves eating grilled cheese.
solver.add(samsung_galaxy_s21 == grilled_cheese)

# Clue 8: Samsung Galaxy S21 and Eric are next to each other.
solver.add(Or(samsung_galaxy_s21 - eric == 1, eric - samsung_galaxy_s21 == 1))

# Clue 9: January is somewhere to the right of September.
solver.add(jan > sept)

        ("Phone", [

            (iphone_13, "iphone 13"),
            (samsung_galaxy_s21, "samsung galaxy s21")
        ]),
        ("Animal", [(bird, "bird"), (horse, "horse"), (cat, "cat")]),
        ("Occupation", [(doctor, "doctor"), (engineer, "engineer"), (teacher, "teacher")]),
        ("Birthday", [(jan, "jan"), (sept, "sept"), (april, "april")]),
        ("Lunch", [(grilled_cheese, "grilled cheese"), (pizza, "pizza"), (spaghetti, "spaghetti")])

        values = []

            for var, label in attributes:

from z3 import *

from z3 import *

names = ["Peter", "Arnold", "Bob", "Alice", "Eric"]
smoothies = ["cherry", "lime", "desert", "dragonfruit", "watermelon"]

name_house = {n: Int(f"name_{n}") for n in names}
smoothie_house = {s: Int(f"smoothie_{s}") for s in smoothies}

solver = Solver()

for v in list(name_house.values()) + list(smoothie_house.values()):
    solver.add(v >= 1, v <= 5)

solver.add(Distinct(*[name_house[n] for n in names]))
solver.add(Distinct(*[smoothie_house[s] for s in smoothies]))

solver.add(smoothie_house["lime"] == 3)
solver.add(name_house["Arnold"] > smoothie_house["dragonfruit"])
solver.add(name_house["Eric"] == 4)
solver.add(name_house["Bob"] < name_house["Alice"])
solver.add(name_house["Bob"] == 3)
solver.add(smoothie_house["watermelon"] < smoothie_house["desert"])
solver.add(name_house["Arnold"] == smoothie_house["cherry"])

if solver.check() == sat:
    model = solver.model()
    for house in range(1, 6):
        occupant = next(n for n in names if model.eval(name_house[n]).as_long() == house)
        smoothie = next(s for s in smoothies if model.eval(smoothie_house[s]).as_long() == house)
        print(f"House {house}: {occupant}, {smoothie}")
else:
    print("unsat")
